code: choices <- c(North = "north", South = "south", East = "east", West = "west")  ui <- fluidPage(   useGlassTabs(),   glassTabsUI("main",     extra_ui = glassMultiSelect(       inputId             = "region",       choices             = choices,       show_style_switcher = FALSE     ),     glassTabPanel("summary", "Summary", selected = TRUE,       shiny::h3("Summary"),       glassFilterTags("region"),        # tag pills appear here       shiny::uiOutput("summary_text")     ),     glassTabPanel("detail", "Detail",       shiny::h3("Detail"),       glassFilterTags("region"),        # same filter, second pane       shiny::tableOutput("detail_table")     )   ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {    # Fall back when an input is NULL or empty (no selection yet).   fallback <- function(x, default) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) default else x    selected_regions <- reactive({     fallback(input$region, unique(unname(choices)))   })    output$summary_text <- renderUI({     shiny::p("Showing data for: ",              shiny::strong(paste(selected_regions(), collapse = ", ")))   })    output$detail_table <- renderTable({     data.frame(Region = selected_regions())   }) }  if (interactive()) shinyApp(ui, server)

code: library(shiny) library(glasstabs)  sales <- data.frame(   region  = c("North", "North", "South", "South", "East", "West"),   product = c("Alpha", "Beta", "Alpha", "Gamma", "Beta", "Alpha"),   revenue = c(42000, 31000, 27000, 55000, 38000, 61000) )  products_by_region <- list(   North = c(Alpha = "Alpha", Beta = "Beta"),   South = c(Alpha = "Alpha", Gamma = "Gamma"),   East  = c(Beta = "Beta"),   West  = c(Alpha = "Alpha") )  ui <- fluidPage(   useGlassTabs(),   glassMultiSelect("region",     c(North = "North", South = "South", East = "East", West = "West"),     show_style_switcher = FALSE   ),   glassMultiSelect("product",     c(Alpha = "Alpha", Beta = "Beta", Gamma = "Gamma"),     show_style_switcher = FALSE,     check_style = "check-only"   ),   glassFilterTags("region"),   glassFilterTags("product"),   actionButton("reset", "Reset filters"),   tableOutput("tbl") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   fallback <- function(x, default) {     if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) default else x   }    # Region drives the product list; keep what still applies.   observeEvent(input$region, {     available <- unique(unlist(       products_by_region[fallback(input$region, names(products_by_region))],       use.names = FALSE     ))     updateGlassMultiSelect(       session, "product",       choices = stats::setNames(available, available),       preserve_selection = TRUE,       drop_invalid = TRUE,       notify = "changed"     )   }, ignoreNULL = FALSE)    observeEvent(input$reset, {     updateGlassMultiSelect(session, "region", selected = character(0))     updateGlassMultiSelect(session, "product", selected = character(0))   })    filtered <- reactive({     sales[       sales$region %in% fallback(input$region, unique(sales$region)) &       sales$product %in% fallback(input$product, unique(sales$product)),     ]   })    output$tbl <- renderTable(filtered()) }  if (interactive()) shinyApp(ui, server)
